reference_sql:
SELECT plan_name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(start_date) = 1) AS q1,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(start_date) = 2) AS q2,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(start_date) = 3) AS q3,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(start_date) = 4) AS q4
FROM subscriptions
WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY plan_name
alternatives:
SELECT plan_name, "1" AS q1, "2" AS q2, "3" AS q3, "4" AS q4
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription started in 2025
  SELECT plan_name, quarter(start_date) AS qtr
  FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
) AS s
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR qtr IN (1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY plan_name)

SELECT plan_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN start_date < DATE '2025-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN start_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND start_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN start_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND start_date < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q3,
  SUM(CASE WHEN start_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q4
FROM subscriptions
WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY plan_name

other_way.sql:
SELECT plan_name, "1" AS q1, "2" AS q2, "3" AS q3, "4" AS q4
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription started in 2025
  SELECT plan_name, quarter(start_date) AS qtr
  FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
) AS s
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR qtr IN (1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY plan_name)
other_way.tradeoff: PIVOT with an IN list of the four quarters is shorter to write, but it is DuckDB syntax that most engines do not run.
